name: What kind of due diligence is recommended when purchasing a luxury waterfront property in Miami?

mainEntity.name: What kind of due diligence is recommended when purchasing a luxury waterfront property in Miami?

acceptedAnswer.text: When purchasing a luxury waterfront property in Miami, thorough due diligence is paramount. This includes a comprehensive property inspection, evaluation of seawall condition, flood zone determination, and assessment of potential insurance costs for flood and hurricane coverage. It's also wise to investigate any specific local regulations or restrictions related to waterfront properties in areas like Key Biscayne or Fort Lauderdale Beach. We can guide you through these crucial steps and connect you with qualified local experts for specialized assessments.
